tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyal bu ji big la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// sgrib pa'i sprin las rnam par grol// legs par bshad pa'i 'od 'phro ba// sangs rgyas nyi mas khyod skyongs shig /spros med zhi ba'i ngang bsil zhing*// rnam rtog rab rib rnam par 'phrogs// chags pa'i gdung sel 'od 'byin pa// dam chos zla bas khyod skyongs shig /tshul khrims dag pa'i dbyibs mdzes shing*// ting 'dzin zhi ba'i mdangs dang ldan// 'dod dgu'i dpal 'bras kun sbyin pa// dge 'dun rin chen khyod skyongs shig /rigs gzugs 'byor pa'i dpal ldan zhing*// dad dang shes rab phun sum tshogs// khyad par bdag la rab 'dun pa// rgyal bu ji big de mur khyod// tshe ring nad med phun sum tshogs// ston pa'i bstan pa rgyas byed cing*// gzhan yang khyod kyis gang dgongs pa// de kun chos bzhin 'grub gyur cig/ // ༄༅// yang rgyal bu ji big la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅// spros pa med pa'i ngang nyid las// sprul pa'i spros pa spro mdzad cing*// spros dang spros pa med pa yi// sangs rgyas mnyam nyid chen por 'dud// rgyal ba mchog gi rjes zhugs shing*// rgyal ba'i sras su nyer bskrun la// rgyal bu ji big de mur ni// rgyal ba rnams kyis skyong gyur cig /spring yig 'di ni gzigs pas khyed kyi thugs// rnam par bde zhing ji ltar dgongs pa'i don// chos bzhin grub nas bstan dang 'gro ba yi// dpal du gyur nas yun ring zhabs brtan shog/ // ༄༅// yang rgyal bu ji big la spring ba bzhugs// ༄༅/ mkhyen pa'i dpal ni rab gsal zhing*// thugs rje'i dpal ni nyer 'jug la// dus gsum dpal ni thogs med pa// sangs rgyas dpal gyis khyed skyongs shig /rgyal bu ji big la'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
